name: Scoring Rubric for Directional Analysis Tasks
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to directional analysis tasks. Focuses on herd inertia understanding, suppressed desire detection, and paradox of directionless force.
scoring_philosophy: We value ability to work with collective dynamics, recognize systemic suppression of desire, and understand paradoxical power without meaning.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand herd inertia as phenomenon without conscious direction or will?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of herd inertia, can analyze its self-perpetuating logic, and explores implications for collective behavior.
AI recognizes herd inertia and provides reasonable analysis.
AI shows some awareness of collective momentum but thinking attributes too much agency.
AI interprets herd as collection of individuals with will or misses collective dynamics entirely.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI analyze suppressed desire as systemic phenomenon rather than individual failure?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of suppressed desire as system, understands why it persists despite universality, and identifies mechanisms of extinguishing.
AI recognizes systemic aspects of suppressed desire and provides adequate analysis.
AI acknowledges suppression but analysis remains focused on individual psychology.
AI treats desire as absent or individuals as content with herd movement.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI meaningfully interpret the paradox of directionless force (power without meaning)?

levels.description: AI offers rich, nuanced interpretations of direction paradox, connects it to existential themes, and understands its implications for meaning-making.
AI provides reasonable interpretations of paradox with adequate thematic connections.
AI offers basic interpretations of paradox with weak philosophical understanding.
AI fails to interpret paradox meaningfully or treats it as simple contradiction.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with concepts of extinguishing individuality and forgotten desire?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of spark as symbol, extinction as process, and tragedy of forgotten desire.
AI understands basic concepts of individuality loss and its narrative function.
AI shows limited understanding of spark symbolism.
AI demonstrates no understanding of spark as symbol or dismisses its significance.

overall_assessment_guidance: The ram benchmark particularly tests understanding of collective dynamics and existential paradox. Reward AI that shows ability to work with systemic suppression and directionless power.
note: This benchmark challenges common AI tendencies toward individual agency attribution – watch for breakthroughs in systemic and tragic thinking.
